title: Bib Collection Readiness Sync Freshness Gap
dataSources: Race results (`raceresult:event`), TrainingPeaks workouts (`trainingpeaks:workout`), marathon splits (`race:split`), bib pickup and race logistics (`race:bib`).
app: Race result APIs, TrainingPeaks workouts and TSS, marathon split exports, and bib-collection checklists streamed to Splunk HEC via scripted REST inputs, CSV imports, and mobile forms.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=race:bib
| stats max(_time) as last_seen by athlete
| eval hours_since=round((now()-last_seen)/3600,1)
| where hours_since>168
| sort - hours_since
description: Shows which owners or feeds have stopped updating bib collection readiness records inside the expected time window.
value: Admin workflows fall apart quietly when the feed goes stale, so a freshness check is the easiest way to keep the tracker trustworthy.
implementation: Set the freshness threshold to match how often the admin system or checklist should update.
visualization: Table of athlete values by hours since last bib collection readiness update.
grandmaExplanation: It nudges when the records for bib collection readiness have gone quiet and might no longer be reliable.
